title: Trash And The crimson swine
paragraphs: “Bubububuhii!?”
“There’s nothing more to discuss with you. You can wrack your brain all you want, but the fact remains that I witnessed everything firsthand. Don’t think you can talk your way out of this.”
“Buhiiiiiiiiii! Buhibuhibuhi!”
“Silence.”
With the queen’s spell, the crimson swine was completely sealed in a cage of ice. The crimson swine tried to cast a spell to melt the ice. I won’t allow it. I quickly nullified the magic.
“Fuhahaha! How pathetic.”
Trapped inside, the crimson swine groaned.
“Father, let’s point and laugh. Evil has been captured.”
“U-uh… yeah…”
As I pointed at the crimson swine and laughed, Father followed suit, though his mood was slightly subdued.
“Gunununununu!”
“Well then, Aultcray, did you listen to my message properly? About entrusting the Seyaette territory to someone capable for the sake of friendship with the demi-humans, among other matters…”
“Why should I do that?!”
“To avoid war.”
“There’s no need for friendship with Siltvelt! Now is the time for war—guh!”
Once again, Trash was struck by the queen. This is getting boring.
“Haa… I’m truly relieved that Kitamura-sama was able to return. It seems there’s no need to defend this man at all.”
Oh! The queen’s signature move.
“I had been considering ways to avoid saying this… but it can’t be helped.”
Ah, how nostalgic.
No… this is just like the time before last, isn’t it?
“I hereby strip both of you of your royal authority permanently.”
“What!?”
“Buhii!?”
“Prepare yourselves for the heavy punishment that will follow.”
The queen declared it with unwavering resolve.
“There will be no letting this slide, understood?”
Trash has been ordered not to be killed, but the crimson swine… well, that’s another matter.
“If I am no longer royalty, the influential figures will not stay silent.”
“Indeed. But it will buy enough time for the heroes to escape. And after that, what awaits you, Aultcray, is your punishment.”
“I will not yield!”
“Very well. I am prepared to counter you as much as necessary… until you repent.”
“Ugh…”
Trash groaned, clearly on the losing side. Come to think of it, despite everything, Trash still harbors feelings for the queen. I recall he even used to dress in a rather ridiculous manner.
“This has turned into a farce. To start, let’s see… Heroes, wouldn’t you like to mete out some punishment to these fools?”
The queen has complete control of the situation.
“I feel like I’m being left behind here…”
It seems Father is having trouble keeping up with the situation.
“Rest assured. It looks like Naofumi-san’s name has been cleared, and we’ll be able to leave this country safely.”
“That’s what I think too, but the situation feels a little uncertain. We’ll have to ask Motoyasu about what comes next.”
I raised my hand.
“Kitamura-sama, please go ahead.”
“A renaming punishment would be fitting. Aultcray shall be called Trash, and that princess shall be called the crimson swine.”
“What!?”
Father, along with Ren and Itsuki, had their voices crack in surprise. However, the queen wore a slight smile.
“Very well. I will issue a decree across the country. From now on, you shall be known as Trash and the crimson swine.”
“Wha!? Spear! You damn fake hero!”
The crimson swine was thrashing around inside the ice prison.
“Well, that’s enough punishment… Imprison Trash and the crimson swine.”

With a snap of the queen’s fingers, the ice melted, and Trash and the crimson swine were dragged away by the shadow and newly arrived knights. Trash and the crimson swine struggled with all their might.
“Get lost already! Paralysis Lance!”
I struck them both simultaneously. They were paralyzed and rendered immobile. Meanwhile, the knights reluctantly tended to the critically injured soldiers and others before taking them away.

“Now then… As you can see, within our country of Melromarc, there has been a movement to persecute the Shield Hero. Even with my authority, I have yet to completely suppress Trash’s faction. It will take some time to dismantle it piece by piece.”
“Ah…”
“I understand the situation.”

“Given these unfavorable outcomes, it’s also highly likely that the dark forces and assassins of the Three Heroes Church will now target my life. I will use as much of my power as possible to restore Melromarc to its former state before the next Wave arrives, but I would advise the heroes to head to Faubrey.”
Here, the queen explained the state of the nation and the situation regarding the summoning of the Four Cardinal Heroes.
“So, going to Faubrey is necessary for us?”
“Yes. That is my analysis… Kitamura-sama, do you have any thoughts?”
“I would prefer to avoid Faubrey for now. Even if we do go, it should be after we have sufficiently strengthened Father and the others to ensure their safety.”
“I assume you have a reason for that?”
“Yes, I do.”

Tact is in Faubrey. Even though I could probably wipe him out by myself, I need to be extra cautious. There are other things that need to be done, and Father, Ren, and Itsuki have warned me that it’s fine to postpone dealing with the mess in Faubrey for now. That’s right. First, we should take care of what needs to be done in Melromarc. Last time, because I eliminated Trash, we couldn’t stay, but this time, thanks to the queen’s assistance, we can remain for a while. That being said, since the Three Heroes Church is likely to go on a rampage, we need to act with extreme caution. Ah, speaking of which, Éclair and the queen told me something.
“As for the Three Heroes Church, I know of a place where they are conducting illegal research.”

Éclair and her team have been investigating and said they have gathered sufficient evidence that the Three Heroes Church is engaging in dangerous research. If we hit them there, it should be enough to keep them in check.
“Please prepare a map.”
“Yes. Bring a map.”
At the queen’s order, a soldier brought a map. Using my knowledge from the previous loops, I pointed out the location of the Three Heroes Church’s research facility, which was a fortress.
“If we raid this place, we should be able to obtain sufficient evidence. If necessary, I wouldn’t mind turning the church of the Three Heroes into ashes right now.”
I can take out the Pope with a preemptive strike, after all.
“It seems we already have enough evidence to silence all the relevant parties. I’ll have them move quickly to confirm it.”
The queen is quite motivated. Well, considering she had to go through summoning the heroes, she can’t exactly deny responsibility now.
“Now then… we’ve managed to thwart the conspiracy beforehand… Motoyasu-san, isn’t it time you told us?”
“It’s not exactly safe yet, but the enemy has been dealt with.”
“Um, Motoyasu-kun, you know something, right? I mean, you seem like you can see everything. Otherwise, none of this makes sense.”
“Motoyasu says he’s been looping through this world multiple times.”
“That’s how he’s able to foresee the various conspiracies and events and is trying to protect us.”
“R-Really!? Now that you mention it, he did say he came to help from the future.”
“Yes, that’s correct.”
I nodded and looked at Father.
“So, where should I begin?”
“Well… since this conspiracy has been dealt with, we’re good on that front, right?”
Everyone nodded in response to Itsuki’s question. It’s been a long road to get here.
“If I remember correctly, in the previous loop, since the queen wasn’t around, the king, the soldiers, and even those who were supposed to become allies were all killed in retaliation, right?”
“Yes, that’s right. After that, I rescued Éclair from the underground prison, burned down the Three Heroes Church with magic, and escaped using a portal.”
“T-That’s quite a gruesome tale…”
Itsuki gave his impression, his words trailing off.
Is that so? I don’t think there was any other option.
